# TASK 2 — Bio Vera seed labels, factory-to-field traceability, approved products & "Where to buy"

> Read this whole file before writing code. Implement **phase by phase**. Finish a phase completely (code + migration + tests + manual check) before starting the next. After each phase, stop and report what was done and how it was verified.

---

## 0. Context and non-negotiable rules

**Business goal.** Bio Vera orders its own seed line from partner seed factories (e.g. NS Seme, Novi Sad). Every bag gets, **in the factory**, a Bio Vera label with a **barcode + QR code generated by the Bio Vera system**. Only codes generated by our system are accepted anywhere ("our codes in, our codes out"). For each bag we must always know: which product/variety, which factory lot, **which seed-crop year**, when and where it was produced, by which factory, quality certificate — and later which supplier received and sold it, which grower bought it, on which parcel it was planted, and which harvest lot / buyer order came from it.

**Rules (apply to every phase):**
1. **English is the base language.** All new UI text via i18n keys: web `web/locales/en.json`, mobile `mobile/i18n/locales/en.json` (other locales fall back to `en`). Backend messages/notifications are English literals. No hardcoded Serbian/German.
2. **Design must match the existing app exactly.**
   - Web admin pages: `AuthGuard requiredRoles={['SUPER_ADMIN','ADMIN']}` + `SidebarLayout` + `useAdminNavItems()` (see `web/app/admin/missions/page.tsx`, `web/app/admin/orders/page.tsx`). Use `web/components/ui/Premium.tsx` (`PremiumCard`, `PremiumStatCard`, `PremiumPageTitle`, `PremiumButton`, `PremiumEyebrow`), brand green `#2D5A27` / hover `#23471f`, white cards `border-gray-200 rounded-lg`, tables with `divide-y divide-gray-200`, `text-sm`. No new colours, fonts or UI libraries.
   - Supplier web portal: follow `web/app/supplier/*` (layout.tsx, SupplierHeader.tsx).
   - Mobile: `mobile/lib/enterprise-ui.ts`, `mobile/design-system/*` (`EnterpriseButton`, `EnterpriseNavSection`, `EnterprisePageTitle`), `TouchableOpacity` (never `Pressable` with a style function — NativeWind breaks it), compact spacing like `mobile/app/(supplier)/dashboard.tsx`.
3. **Real data only** — no mocks, placeholders or fake numbers. Every empty state says what to do next.
4. **Database:** schema changes in `backend/prisma/schema.prisma` + one migration folder per phase `backend/prisma/migrations/<YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>_<name>/migration.sql` (generate with `npx prisma migrate diff --from-url <local db> --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script`, review it, then `npx prisma migrate deploy` locally). **Never** run anything against production. Migrations are applied in production by the owner.
5. **Do not break existing flows**: grower seed scan (`/seeds/validate`, `/smart-lock/scan`), supplier catalogue/orders/threads, supplier map, digital passport, marketplace/catalogue work from Task 1, orders/dispatch/delivery. Existing tests must stay green.
6. **Security:** role guards on every endpoint (`@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)` + `@Roles(...)`), DTOs with class-validator (global ValidationPipe uses `whitelist + forbidNonWhitelisted`), never return password hashes or other users' personal data (a global `StripSecretsInterceptor` exists, don't rely on it alone).
7. **Offline-friendly scanning on mobile:** a scan made without network must not be lost (queue it like other offline writes in `mobile/lib/offline-storage.ts` / `mobile/lib/sync-service.ts`) and be validated when the connection returns; the UI says "Saved — will be verified when online".

## PHASE 1 — PILOT: our codes, printable labels, verified planting scan

Scope: one approved Bio Vera seed product, one factory, one production run, labels generated by us, printed by the factory, grower scan accepts **only** our codes, public verification page. (Suppliers hand bags to growers outside the system in this phase — admin assigns bags to a grower.)

### 1.1 Schema (migration `<ts>_seed_production_pilot`)

```prisma
enum ApprovedProductCategory { SEED FERTILIZER PLANT_PROTECTION PACKAGING OTHER }
enum ApprovedProductStatus  { ACTIVE RETIRED }

/// Bio Vera list of recommended inputs (phase 3 restricts suppliers to this list).
model approved_products {
  id             String                  @id @default(uuid())
  category       ApprovedProductCategory
  name           String                  // "Bio Vera Raspberry seed – Willamette"
  variety        String?
  cropType       String?                 // must match planting cropType values used in the app
  manufacturer   String?
  isBioVeraBrand Boolean                 @default(false)
  description    String?
  imageUrl       String?
  unit           String                  // "bag"
  packSize       String?                 // "5 kg", "10 000 seeds"
  status         ApprovedProductStatus   @default(ACTIVE)
  createdAt      DateTime                @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime                @updatedAt
  productionRuns seed_production_runs[]
  seeds          seeds[]
}

/// Partner factory.
model seed_producers {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  name          String
  country       String
  city          String?
  address       String?
  licenseNumber String?
  contactName   String?
  contactEmail  String?
  userId        String?  @unique   // phase 3: producer portal account
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
  runs          seed_production_runs[]
}

enum SeedRunStatus { PLANNED LABELS_ISSUED PRODUCED RELEASED RECALLED }

/// One factory production lot.
model seed_production_runs {
  id                String        @id @default(uuid())
  approvedProductId String
  producerId        String
  lotNumber         String        @unique   // uppercase A–Z0–9, 3–12 chars, e.g. NS2604
  seedCropYear      Int                     // e.g. 2026
  productionDate    DateTime?
  originCountry     String
  originRegion      String?
  bagSizeLabel      String                  // "5 kg"
  bagsPlanned       Int                     // 1..20000
  bagsProduced      Int?
  germinationPct    Float?
  purityPct         Float?
  certificateUrls   String[]
  expiresAt         DateTime?
  status            SeedRunStatus @default(PLANNED)
  recallReason      String?
  createdBy         String?
  createdAt         DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime      @updatedAt
  approvedProduct   approved_products @relation(fields: [approvedProductId], references: [id])
  producer          seed_producers    @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id])
  bags              seeds[]
  @@index([status])
}

enum SeedCustodyEvent { LABEL_ISSUED PRODUCED VOIDED RELEASED ASSIGNED_TO_GROWER SHIPPED_TO_SUPPLIER RECEIVED_BY_SUPPLIER SOLD_TO_GROWER PLANTED RECALLED }

model seed_custody_events {
  id             String           @id @default(uuid())
  seedId         String
  event          SeedCustodyEvent
  actorId        String?
  supplierUserId String?
  growerId       String?
  parcelId       String?
  lat            Float?
  lng            Float?
  note           String?
  createdAt      DateTime         @default(now())
  seed           seeds            @relation(fields: [seedId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@index([seedId, createdAt])
}
```

Extend `seeds` (one row = one physical bag):
```prisma
  productionRunId   String?
  approvedProductId String?
  seedCropYear      Int?
  bagNumber         Int?
  supplierUserId    String?
  soldToGrowerId    String?
  soldAt            DateTime?
  plantedParcelId   String?
  plantedAt         DateTime?
  plantingId        String?      // harvest_announcements (PLANTING) the bag was used for
  productionRun     seed_production_runs? @relation(fields: [productionRunId], references: [id])
  approvedProduct   approved_products?    @relation(fields: [approvedProductId], references: [id])
  custody           seed_custody_events[]
  @@index([productionRunId])
```
Add to `enum SeedStatus` (keep existing values): `LABELED`, `VOIDED`, `IN_SUPPLIER_STOCK`, `SOLD`, `PLANTED`, `RECALLED`.

### 1.2 Serial number & check code — `backend/src/seed-production/seed-serial.ts`

Format (what is encoded in the barcode and printed under it):
```
BV-26-NS2604-000123-7K4Q
│  │  │      │      └── CHECK: 4 chars, Crockford base32 of HMAC-SHA256(secret, "BV-26-NS2604-000123")
│  │  │      └── bag number, 6 digits, zero-padded
│  │  └── factory lot number (run.lotNumber)
│  └── seed-crop year, 2 digits
└── Bio Vera prefix
```
- Secret: `process.env.SEED_LABEL_SECRET`, fallback `JWT_SECRET`; throw at startup of the module if neither exists. **Document in `backend/.env.example`** and in the phase report that this secret must never change once labels are printed.
- Export: `buildSeedSerial(year, lot, bagNo)`, `parseSeedSerial(input)` → `{ ok, year, lot, bagNo, serial } | { ok:false, reason:'FORMAT'|'CHECK' }`.
- `parseSeedSerial` must accept: the bare serial, lowercase, with spaces, **and the QR URL** `https://biovera.app/s/<serial>` (also `/verify/seed/<serial>`, `http://`, `www.`, trailing slash, query string), extracting the serial. See §1.9.
- Compare check codes with `crypto.timingSafeEqual`.
- Unit tests `seed-serial.spec.ts`: round-trip; lowercase/spaces/URL accepted; any single changed character → `CHECK`; wrong shape → `FORMAT`; different secret → `CHECK`.

### 1.3 Label generation — `backend/src/seed-production/seed-labels.ts`
- Add dependency **`bwip-js`** to `backend/package.json` (Code128 image generation, pure JS).
- `buildLabelsCsv(run, bags)` → columns: `serial,bag_number,lot,seed_crop_year,product,variety,bag_size,production_country,expires,verify_url`.
- `buildLabelsPdf(run, bags)` with pdfkit:
  - A4, **3 × 8 labels per page (70 × 37 mm)**, 0 mm gaps — standard sticker sheet; also support `?format=roll` → one label per page 100 × 60 mm for thermal printers.
  - Each label: Bio Vera logo (copy `web/public/biovera-logo.png` to `backend/assets/biovera-logo.png` and make sure it is included in the build output), product name + variety, `Lot NS2604 · Seed year 2026 · 5 kg`, `Best before MM/YYYY` if set, **Code128 barcode of the serial** (bwip-js PNG), human-readable serial under it, **QR** of `https://biovera.app/s/<serial>` (qrcode package, error correction M), small text "Scan for instructions & authenticity". See §1.9.
  - Barcode must scan reliably: Code128, module height ≥ 10 mm, quiet zones respected. Verify by scanning a printed/PDF label with the mobile app (`scan-qr.tsx` supports `code128` and `qr`).

### 1.4 Backend module `backend/src/seed-production/`
Files: `seed-production.module.ts`, `seed-production.controller.ts`, `seed-production.service.ts`, `dto/*.ts`, `seed-serial.ts`, `seed-labels.ts`, specs. Register in `app.module.ts`. Every state change writes an `audit_trails` row (pattern: `backend/src/orders/order-stock.ts#audit`).

Admin endpoints (`ADMIN`, `SUPER_ADMIN`):

| Method & path | Body / result | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `GET/POST /seed-production/approved-products`, `PATCH /…/:id`, `POST /…/:id/retire` | CRUD | name, category, unit required |
| `GET/POST /seed-production/producers`, `PATCH /…/:id` | CRUD | name, country required |
| `GET /seed-production/runs` | list with counts per status | |
| `POST /seed-production/runs` | `{ approvedProductId, producerId, lotNumber, seedCropYear, originCountry, originRegion?, bagSizeLabel, bagsPlanned, expiresAt? }` → PLANNED | lotNumber unique, uppercase `^[A-Z0-9]{3,12}$`; year 2000..current+1; product must be ACTIVE and category SEED |
| `POST /seed-production/runs/:id/issue-labels` | → LABELS_ISSUED; creates `bagsPlanned` `seeds` rows (`status LABELED`, serial via `buildSeedSerial`, `type SEED`, name = product name, `batchNumber = lotNumber`, `seedCropYear`, `bagNumber`, `quantity` from bag size if numeric kg else 1, `areaCoverage` 0, `manufacturedAt = now` until confirmed) + custody `LABEL_ISSUED` | only from PLANNED; idempotent (second call returns existing) ; use `createMany` in chunks of 1000 inside a transaction |
| `GET /seed-production/runs/:id/labels.csv` / `labels.pdf?format=sheet\|roll` | file download (`Content-Disposition: attachment`) | only when LABELS_ISSUED or later |
| `POST /seed-production/runs/:id/confirm-production` | `{ bagsProduced, productionDate, germinationPct?, purityPct?, certificateUrls?[] }` → PRODUCED; bags `1..bagsProduced` → `AVAILABLE` + custody PRODUCED; bags above → `VOIDED` + custody VOIDED; `manufacturedAt = productionDate` | `0 < bagsProduced ≤ bagsPlanned`; only from LABELS_ISSUED |
| `POST /seed-production/runs/:id/release` | → RELEASED + custody RELEASED on AVAILABLE bags | only from PRODUCED |
| `POST /seed-production/runs/:id/recall` | `{ reason }` → RECALLED; all non-PLANTED bags → `RECALLED` + custody; **notify** every grower who holds or planted a bag of this run (English: `Seed lot NS2604 recalled`, reason, what to do) ; response lists affected parcels | from PRODUCED/RELEASED |
| `POST /seed-production/runs/:id/assign` | `{ growerId or growerPartnerCode, serials: string[] }` (pilot hand-over) → bags `ASSIGNED`, `assignedToUserId`, `soldToGrowerId`, `soldAt`, custody `ASSIGNED_TO_GROWER` | run RELEASED; bag AVAILABLE; every serial must pass `parseSeedSerial` |
| `GET /seed-production/bags/:serial` | bag + run + product + producer + full custody timeline + scans | serial parsed first |
| `GET /seed-production/dashboard` | per run: labeled / produced / voided / available / assigned / planted / recalled; parcels planted with Bio Vera seed | |

Public (no auth): `GET /public/seed/verify/:serial` →
```json
{ "genuine": true, "state": "OK" | "USED" | "RECALLED" | "EXPIRED" | "VOIDED" | "NOT_RELEASED",
  "product": "Bio Vera Raspberry seed – Willamette", "variety": "Willamette",
  "lotNumber": "NS2604", "seedCropYear": 2026, "bagSize": "5 kg",
  "producer": { "name": "NS Seme", "city": "Novi Sad", "country": "RS" },
  "productionDate": "2026-03-02", "germinationPct": 92 }
```
Unknown/invalid → `{ "genuine": false, "reason": "NOT_A_BIO_VERA_CODE" }` (HTTP 200, no details). **Never** return grower, supplier or parcel data here. Rate-limit this route (reuse any existing throttling; otherwise simple in-memory per-IP 30/min).

### 1.5 Grower scan — make it accept only our codes
Change both entry points so they share one function `SeedProductionService.checkBagForPlanting(serialInput, userId)`:
- `GET /seeds/validate/:serialNumber` (`seeds.service.ts#validateSeed`)
- `POST /smart-lock/scan` (`smart-lock.service.ts#validateAndLinkSeed` and `ensureSeedLinkedToParcel`)

Logic, in this order, each with its own English error message and `seed_scans` row (`isValid=false`, `validationError=<CODE>`):
1. `parseSeedSerial` fails → `NOT_A_BIO_VERA_CODE` — "This is not a Bio Vera seed code."
   - **Legacy exception:** if the input is not in `BV-` format but exists in `seeds` without `productionRunId` (old data), keep the current behaviour so existing growers aren't broken. Log it as `LEGACY_SEED`.
2. Bag not found → `NOT_A_BIO_VERA_CODE`.
3. Run `RECALLED` or bag `RECALLED` → `RECALLED` — "This seed lot was recalled. Do not plant it — contact Bio Vera."
4. Bag `VOIDED` or run not RELEASED → `NOT_RELEASED`.
5. `expiresAt` passed → `EXPIRED`.
6. Bag already `PLANTED`/`USED` → `ALREADY_USED` — "This bag was already registered on <date>."
7. Bag not assigned/sold to this user → `NOT_YOURS` — "This bag is not registered to your account. Ask your supplier or Bio Vera."
8. OK → on smart-lock scan with parcel: bag `PLANTED`, `plantedParcelId`, `plantedAt`, link `plantingId` to the grower's open PLANTING plan on that parcel with matching cropType (if exactly one), custody `PLANTED` with GPS, keep existing parcel ACTIVE behaviour. On `/seeds/validate` only validate (no state change).
- Success response adds `origin`: product, variety, lot, seedCropYear, producer name/city/country, productionDate, germinationPct, certificateUrls.

Mobile (`SeedRegistrationScreen.tsx` + `scan-qr.tsx`):
- Pass the raw scanned value (may be the QR URL) — backend parses it.
- On success show a **"Genuine Bio Vera seed"** card (green check, product, variety, `Lot NS2604 · Seed year 2026`, producer + city, germination %) instead of a plain alert.
- On error show the specific message for each code above.
- Manual entry field accepts the printed serial.
- Offline: queue the scan (serial, GPS, parcel, device time) and show "Saved — will be verified when online".

### 1.9 One QR, two behaviours: phone camera → instructions website, Bio Vera app → this exact bag

**What goes on the bag (both printed by the factory from our label file):**
- **QR code** = URL `https://biovera.app/s/<SERIAL>` (short path keeps the QR small and easy to scan).
- **Code128 barcode** = the bare `<SERIAL>` (for supplier USB/handheld scanners and warehouse systems).
- Human-readable serial under the barcode.

**Behaviour A — any phone camera / any QR app (no Bio Vera app):** the URL opens the website:
- New route `web/app/s/[serial]/page.tsx` (server component) → calls `GET /public/seed/verify/:serial` and renders **one page = instructions + authenticity**:
  1. Header: product name, variety, bag size, Bio Vera logo, green "Genuine Bio Vera seed — Lot NS2604 · Seed year 2026 · produced by NS Seme, Novi Sad" (or red "Not a genuine Bio Vera code" — then no instructions, only a contact link).
  2. **Usage instructions for this product** (from the approved product, see below): sowing/planting time, spacing & depth, seed rate per ha, soil & temperature, irrigation, first steps after sowing, storage of opened bag, safety notes, expected harvest window.
  3. Quality data of this lot: production date, germination %, purity %, certificate links, best before.
  4. State notices: RECALLED → red banner "Do not use — contact Bio Vera", EXPIRED → warning, already PLANTED → "This bag was already registered" (no personal data).
  5. Call to action: "Grow with Bio Vera — download the app" (App Store / Google Play links) + "Already a Bio Vera grower? Open in the app" (link `biovera://seed/<serial>`).
  6. Language switcher like the rest of the site; page is `noindex`.
- `/verify/seed/<serial>` (from §1.7) becomes a redirect to `/s/<serial>` so there is one page.

**Behaviour B — scanned inside the Bio Vera mobile app:** the app never opens the website. `mobile/app/scan-qr.tsx` passes the raw value; the backend `parseSeedSerial` extracts the serial from the URL; the grower gets the planting flow for **that exact bag** (§1.5), the supplier gets receive/sell for that bag (phase 2), admin lookup shows its timeline.

**Behaviour C — phone camera when the app is installed:** the camera opens the **app directly** on that bag (universal links / Android app links):
- Web: add `web/public/.well-known/apple-app-site-association` (no extension, served as `application/json`; `applinks` for appID `<TEAM_ID>.com.biovera.app`, paths `/s/*`) and `web/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json` (package `com.biovera.app`, SHA-256 of the release signing cert). Ensure Next.js/Vercel serves them with the right content type and without redirect (add headers in `web/next.config.*` if needed). Put `TEAM_ID` and the SHA-256 as clearly marked placeholders **and list them in the phase report** — the owner fills them from Apple Developer / Play Console.
- Mobile `mobile/app.json`: `ios.associatedDomains: ["applinks:biovera.app", "applinks:www.biovera.app"]`; `android.intentFilters` with `autoVerify: true`, scheme `https`, hosts `biovera.app` and `www.biovera.app`, `pathPrefix: "/s/"`. (Takes effect in the next native build, not in Expo Go.)
- Mobile route `mobile/app/s/[serial].tsx` (expo-router resolves the universal link path): if not signed in → login then continue; GROWER/FARMER → seed scan result/plant-on-parcel flow for that serial; MATERIAL_SUPPLIER → bag detail with Receive/Sell; ADMIN → bag timeline; BUYER/other → show the same instructions view in-app (fetch `/public/seed/verify/:serial` + instructions).
- Also handle the custom scheme `biovera://seed/<serial>` with the same screen.

**Instructions content (admin-managed, per approved product):**
- Add to `approved_products`: `instructions Json?` with fixed sections `{ sowingTime, spacingDepth, seedRate, soilTemperature, irrigation, firstSteps, storage, safety, harvestWindow }` (each markdown/plain text, English base) + `instructionsPdfUrl String?` + `videoUrl String?`.
- Admin approved-product form gets an **Instructions** tab with those fields, a live preview identical to `/s/<serial>`, and a "Preview with a real bag" button.
- If instructions are empty the public page shows only authenticity + contact, never placeholder text.

**Tests for §1.9:** `parseSeedSerial` accepts all URL variants; `/s/<valid>` renders genuine + instructions (web component test or Playwright if available); `/s/<tampered>` renders "not genuine" without instructions; AASA and assetlinks files are served with `application/json`; mobile route `s/[serial]` exists and routes by role (unit test for the role→screen mapping).

**Acceptance for §1.9:**
1. Print/PDF label → scan the QR with the **iPhone Camera app** (Bio Vera app not installed or Expo Go) → Safari opens `biovera.app/s/…` with product instructions + "Genuine Bio Vera seed".
2. Scan the same QR **inside the Bio Vera app** (Seed registration) → planting flow for that exact bag (no website).
3. Scan the **Code128** with the app or a USB scanner in admin lookup → same bag.
4. Tampered QR/serial → website says "not genuine", app says "This is not a Bio Vera seed code".
5. (After the next native build + filled TEAM_ID/SHA-256) Camera scan with the app installed opens the app on that bag.

- PDF endpoint returns `application/pdf` and non-empty body; CSV row count = bagsPlanned.

### Phase 1 acceptance (verify manually, locally)
1. Admin creates product "Bio Vera Raspberry seed – Willamette", producer "NS Seme, Novi Sad, RS", run `NS2604`, year 2026, 24 bags.
2. Issue labels → download sticker PDF: 24 labels on one A4 page, each with logo, text, Code128 and QR; CSV has 24 rows.
3. **Scan a label from the screen/print with the mobile app** (both the barcode and the QR) → the app recognises it.
4. Confirm 22 produced → 2 voided; release; assign 3 bags to LOCAL-FARMER.
5. LOCAL-FARMER scans bag 1 on a parcel → "Genuine Bio Vera seed — Lot NS2604 · Seed year 2026 · NS Seme"; admin lookup shows the full timeline incl. GPS.
6. Same bag again → "already registered"; bag 10 (not assigned) → "not registered to your account"; a typed code with one changed character → "not a Bio Vera seed code"; voided bag → rejected.
7. `/s/<serial>` (and `/verify/seed/<serial>` → redirect) shows genuine + state + instructions, no personal data; random code shows "not genuine".
8. Recall NS2604 → bag 2 can't be planted; the farmer gets a notification; admin sees parcel of bag 1 as affected.

## PHASE 2 — Suppliers in the chain: receive, sell, "Where to buy"

### 2.1 Schema (migration `<ts>_seed_supplier_chain`)
- `supplier_catalog_items`: add `approvedProductId String?` + relation to `approved_products`.
- (bags already have `supplierUserId`, `soldToGrowerId`, `soldAt`).

### 2.2 Backend
- Admin: `POST /seed-production/runs/:id/ship` `{ supplierUserId, serials[] }` → bags must be AVAILABLE in a RELEASED run → `supplierUserId` set, status stays AVAILABLE until received, custody `SHIPPED_TO_SUPPLIER`. Supplier must have role `MATERIAL_SUPPLIER` and `mapApproved`.
- Supplier (`MATERIAL_SUPPLIER`, only own bags), in `backend/src/b2b-suppliers/`:
  - `POST /b2b-suppliers/me/seed-bags/receive { serials[] }` → only bags shipped to this supplier → `IN_SUPPLIER_STOCK`, custody `RECEIVED_BY_SUPPLIER`. Response: accepted / rejected per serial with reason.
  - `GET /b2b-suppliers/me/seed-bags?status=` → stock grouped by approved product + lot.
  - `POST /b2b-suppliers/me/seed-bags/sell { growerPartnerCode | growerId, serials[], directOrderId? }` → `SOLD`, `assignedToUserId`, `soldToGrowerId`, `soldAt`, custody `SOLD_TO_GROWER`; notify grower ("You received 2 bags of Bio Vera Raspberry seed (lot NS2604). Scan each bag when planting."). If `directOrderId` given, it must be this supplier's order with this grower.
- Planting check from phase 1 now also accepts bags sold by a supplier (same `assignedToUserId` rule).
- Supplier catalogue: new items **must** have `approvedProductId` (name/unit/image come from the approved product, supplier sets `listPrice`, `sku`). Existing free-text items remain for the supplier but are **excluded from the public map** until admin links them (`PATCH /admin/supplier-catalog-items/:id { approvedProductId }` in admin supplier-stores).
- Map endpoint(s) used by `mobile/app/supplier-map.tsx` and web: only `mapApproved` suppliers; items only with an ACTIVE approved product; add per supplier `bioVeraSeedInStock: [{ approvedProductId, name, bags }]` (count of IN_SUPPLIER_STOCK). Query params `category`, `bioVeraOnly`.

### 2.3 UI
- Admin run detail: **Ship to supplier** (supplier select + serial list/range + preview).
- Admin supplier-stores: column "Approved items / Unlinked items", action to link an item to an approved product.
- Supplier web (`web/app/supplier/`): new page **Seed stock** (receive by scanning/typing serials — USB scanner friendly; stock by product/lot; sell form with grower partner code + serials + optional direct order). Catalogue page: "Add item" opens a picker of approved products (no free-text).
- Supplier mobile (`mobile/app/(supplier)/`): **Receive bags** and **Sell bags** screens using the existing camera scanner (`/scan-qr` pattern, continuous scanning list with ✓/✗ per bag), stock screen.
- Grower map (`mobile/app/supplier-map.tsx`): category filter + "Bio Vera seed" toggle; supplier card shows Bio Vera seed in stock.

### 2.4 Phase 2 tests & acceptance
Integration: ship 5 to Supplier A → A receives 5 (a bag shipped to B is rejected) → A sells 2 to farmer → farmer plants one OK → A can't sell a bag already sold → A can't add a free-text catalogue item → map shows A with "Bio Vera seed: 3 bags" and hides unlinked items.
Manual: same flow on web + mobile, scanning printed labels.

## PHASE 3 — Producer portal, traceability to the passport, reporting

### 3.1 Producer portal
- Add `SEED_PRODUCER` to `enum UserRole` (migration `<ts>_seed_producer_role`); admin "Invite producer user" on the producer page (creates user with this role linked via `seed_producers.userId`, sends the normal account e-mail/verification).
- Web `/seed-producer` (layout like `web/app/supplier/layout.tsx`): **My runs** (only runs of their producer), **Download labels**, **Confirm production** (same form as admin, certificate upload). Post-login redirect for `SEED_PRODUCER` → `/seed-producer` (`web/lib/post-login-redirect.ts`).
- Backend guards: producer endpoints check `run.producer.userId === req.user.id`.

### 3.2 Seed origin in the product passport
- When a harvest lot (`batches`) comes from a parcel that has a PLANTED Bio Vera bag (via `plantedParcelId` / `plantingId`), expose `seedOrigin` in the passport/verify APIs used by `web/app/passport/[batchId]` and `web/app/verify/[batchId]`, and render a "Seed origin" section: product, variety, lot, seed year, producer + city, germination. (No grower personal data beyond what the passport already shows.)
- Admin → Supply (Task 1) shows a "Bio Vera seed" badge on plantings with planted bags.

### 3.3 Reporting
- `/admin/seed-production` dashboard adds: per product and seed year — produced / at suppliers / sold / planted / recalled; parcels planted with Bio Vera seed (list + link to parcel); recall impact view.
- CSV export of the bag register (serial, run, status, supplier, grower partner code, parcel, dates).

### 3.4 Phase 3 acceptance
Producer user logs in → sees only NS Seme runs → downloads labels → confirms production with a certificate; a harvest lot from a parcel planted with a Bio Vera bag shows "Seed origin: … lot NS2604, 2026, NS Seme" on its public passport; dashboard numbers match the DB.

## Definition of done (every phase)
- `cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npx jest && npm run test:integration` (integration needs `JWT_SECRET`; uses a disposable Postgres — see `backend/scripts/run-isolated-tests.cjs`).
- `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit`
- `cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test`
- Manual acceptance list of the phase done locally (backend `PORT=3000`, web `next dev -p 3001`, mobile Expo) with local accounts `LOCAL-ADMIN/-FARMER/-SUPPLIER` (`backend/scripts/seed-local-dev.cjs`; password in gitignored `backend/scripts/local-dev-users.json`). Node 22: `export PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH`.
- New env var `SEED_LABEL_SECRET` added to `backend/.env.example` with a comment; report it so the owner can set it in Railway **before** the first labels are printed.
- Short report: what changed (files), migrations to run in production, env vars to set, how it was verified.

## Do NOT
- Do not let the factory or suppliers generate codes; only `issue-labels` creates serials.
- Do not change the serial format or the secret after labels exist.
- Do not delete bags or custody events — use statuses (VOIDED, RECALLED).
- Do not expose grower/supplier identities on public endpoints.
- Do not replace the official legal seed declaration/label — ours is an additional Bio Vera label.
